title: What determines your chronotype: genetics vs. environment

source.name: Chronotype genome-wide association study
source.publisher: Jones et al., genome-wide association analysis of ~700,000 individuals (as reported by sleep-genetics research summaries)

notes: A genome-wide association analysis of 697,828 people identified 351 genetic loci influencing chronotype; twin studies estimate roughly 44% of differences in natural sleep timing are inherited, with the rest coming from environment and habits. Figures approximate as publicly reported.
